headline: Why hasn't my soulmate found me yet?
note: generated from REVIEW-new-voice.md — not a wired draft

a: You turned the Magician. Three backs, no way to tell, and you took the worker of the three.
Look at his hands. Both are busy, and neither is resting.
You asked why your soulmate hasn't found you yet. What catches me is that both hands have something to do.
The part that doesn't fit is that nobody has found you. And you're the one who has been waiting.
Whatever holds this hasn't shifted. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Nothing showed which was which, and yours was the only card still growing.
Look at the wood he hangs from. It's alive, with green leaves on it.
You asked why your soulmate hasn't found you yet. What holds my eye is that the wood is still living.
Still, nobody has found you. And the question has come back to you.
Something is standing between you and this, close in. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what's behind this…
c: You turned the Fool. Face down, all three, and you took the one already on his way.
Look at his feet. One is lifted, and the other is following it.
You asked why your soulmate hasn't found you yet. The journey in this one is already under way.
But nobody has found you. And you're still the one waiting.
Something is there at the start of it, turning up just as things move. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
